/en-us/airport-assistance/: Flight delayed or canceled in Thailand, or your bag didn’t arrive? Learn what to tell the airline at the airport and which reports and receipts to keep for a later claim or certificate request.
/en-us/airport-assistance/airlines/: Airline help for US–Thailand travelers: search by airline, code or flight number for delay certificates, cancellation and baggage reporting steps, including United’s LAX and SFO routes via Hong Kong.
/en-us/airport-assistance/airlines/unite: United Airlines US to Thailand: UA820 flies Los Angeles to Bangkok via Hong Kong (not nonstop), and San Francisco connects UA877 to UA820. Check-in, return flights, LAX lost property and contacts.
/en-us/airport-assistance/airports/: Airport information in Thailand for US travelers: open guides for Bangkok Suvarnabhumi, Don Mueang, Phuket and Chiang Mai, plus check-in at US airports, airline reporting and route information.
/en-us/airport-assistance/airports/bkk/: Arriving at Bangkok Suvarnabhumi from the US? Clear immigration, claim bags and report any baggage issue before exiting. Find AOT Limousine, rental cars at Door 7 and the Airport Rail Link on B1.
/en-us/airport-assistance/airports/bkk/m: Long layover in Bangkok? Use this interactive Suvarnabhumi terminal map to find ATMs, money exchange, prayer rooms and stores on each level of the main terminal, concourses A to G and SAT-1.
/en-us/airport-assistance/airports/bkk/s: Where can you smoke at Bangkok airport? Suvarnabhumi’s outdoor smoking rooms are outside Doors 1 and 10 on Levels 2 and 4; past immigration, travelers report one near Burger King in Concourse D.
/en-us/airport-assistance/airports/bkk/t: Bangkok airport to city: how US travelers get from Suvarnabhumi to their hotel by Airport Rail Link, metered taxi (plus 50-baht fee and tolls), Grab, Bolt or a pre-booked pickup, with fares compared.
/en-us/airport-assistance/airports/cnx/: Chiang Mai Airport (CNX) tips: airport hours are 6 a.m. to midnight, the Grab service center on domestic Level 1 runs 24/7, and the city shuttle leaves from Door 12. Phone: +66 53 922 000.
/en-us/airport-assistance/airports/dmk/: Flying into Don Mueang (DMK) in Bangkok? Terminal 1 is international and Terminal 2 domestic, so check which you need for a connection. Find banks, ATMs and shops; call +66 2 535 1192 for help.
/en-us/airport-assistance/airports/hkt/: Phuket Airport (HKT) arrival guide: international arrivals are on Level 1 with baggage claim belts 1–5, and self-check-in kiosks are on Level 3 departures. Domestic flights use another terminal.
/en-us/airport-assistance/airports/lax/: Flying LAX to Bangkok on United? Check in at Terminal 7 per LAX’s July 2026 airline map, confirm your counter and cutoff with United, and use +1 800-241-6522 for general airline support.
/en-us/airport-assistance/departure-airp: Check-in and contacts at US airports for Thailand flights: United at LAX Terminal 7 and SFO International Terminal G, Level 3, Aisles 1–2, plus baggage, lost-property and reservations contacts.
/en-us/airport-assistance/flights/: Flights from the USA to Thailand: compare United UA820 from LAX via Hong Kong and UA877 plus UA820 from SFO, with return flights UA821 and UA878. None are nonstop; dates verified for December 2026.
/en-us/airport-assistance/guides/damaged: Suitcase damaged on a US–Thailand flight? Show it to airline staff before leaving the airport, take photos, get a Property Irregularity Report (PIR), then meet the airline’s written notice deadline.
/en-us/airport-assistance/guides/find-ai: How to find the right airline counter at the airport: confirm the operating airline, local departure date and flight number, then check the screens. Check-in, ticketing and baggage desks differ.
/en-us/airport-assistance/guides/insuran: How to file a travel insurance claim, with Allianz US as an example: documents for baggage delay, trip delay and lost or damaged bags, and how secondary baggage coverage works by plan and state.
/en-us/airport-assistance/guides/late-ar: Landing late at Bangkok Suvarnabhumi after a flight delay? The Airport Rail Link runs 5:30 a.m. to midnight, while taxis between gates 4 and 7 and the Grab pickup by gate 4 operate 24 hours.
/en-us/airport-assistance/pairs/sfo-bkk/: San Francisco to Bangkok flights: United UA877 to Hong Kong connecting to UA820, and UA821 plus UA878 for the return. Not nonstop; check in at SFO International Terminal G, Level 3, Aisles 1–2.
/en-us/airport-assistance/routes/united-: Bangkok to Los Angeles on United UA821: a daily flight via Hong Kong that keeps one flight number but is not nonstop. Verified for a December 18, 2026 departure; check today’s status and your ticket.
Bangkok to San Francisco on United: fly UA821 to Hong Kong, then change to UA878 for SFO. A daily connecting itinerary, verified for December 18, 2026; check schedule changes before you travel.
Los Angeles to Bangkok on United UA820: a daily one-stop flight through Hong Kong under the same flight number. Booking verified for December 18, 2026; check aircraft change notes and today’s status.
San Francisco to Bangkok on United: UA877 to Hong Kong, then change planes to UA820. Daily connecting service verified for December 18, 2026, with links to flight status and delay help.
/en-us/attractions/ancient-city-muang-bo: Planning a trip to the Ancient City near Bangkok? Muang Boran recreates Thai palaces and temples in one open-air park. Get hours, the 800-baht foreign ticket, golf cart and car entry rules.
/en-us/attractions/aquaria-phuket/: Aquaria Phuket tickets and hours: this mall aquarium at Central Phuket Floresta runs 11 a.m. to 7 p.m., with otters, penguins and rays. Compare aquarium-only and MAYA combo tickets before you buy.
/en-us/attractions/ayutthaya-historical-: Visiting Ayutthaya from Bangkok? The park is a set of scattered temple ruins, not one gated site. See which to prioritize, from Wat Mahathat’s tree-root Buddha head to riverside Wat Chaiwatthanaram.
/en-us/attractions/bangsaen-aquarium/: Bangsaen Aquarium in Chonburi is a university marine science museum, open 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. and closed Mondays. Catch the 2:30 p.m. diver feeding, touch pool times and tide-pool to big-tank exhibits.
/en-us/attractions/bophut-fishermans-vil: What is Fisherman’s Village in Koh Samui like? It is a beachfront street in Bophut where old wooden shophouses now house boutiques, hotels and seafood spots, better for strolling than swimming.
/en-us/attractions/bridge-over-river-kwa: Visiting the River Kwai Bridge in Kanchanaburi? Learn the WWII Death Railway history, why the real steel bridge differs from the 1957 movie, and how walking the bridge and riding the train differ.
/en-us/attractions/bueng-boraphet-aquari: Bueng Boraphet Aquarium in Nakhon Sawan has a 24-meter freshwater tunnel and 33-plus tanks. Learn why the aquarium, lake and visitor center are separate stops and which fish you will actually see.
/en-us/attractions/bueng-chawak-aquarium: Bueng Chawak Aquarium in Suphan Buri is open 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. weekdays, until 5 p.m. weekends. Check if your ticket covers the freshwater tunnel, the marine tunnel or the shark tank building.
/en-us/attractions/categories/markets/: Looking for the best markets in Thailand? Browse 12 night, weekend and floating markets in Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Phuket and Hua Hin, with notes on which open only on certain days of the week.
/en-us/attractions/categories/temples/: Thailand temples to visit, sorted by region: 30 picks from Bangkok’s Wat Pho, Wat Arun and Wat Phra Kaew to Chiang Mai, Chiang Rai, Ayutthaya and Sukhothai, each with its own visitor guide.
/en-us/attractions/categories/theme-wate: Best theme parks and water parks in Thailand for families: compare Siam Amazing Park in Bangkok, Dream World’s Snow Town, Andamanda Phuket and Ramayana near Pattaya, plus ride height rules for kids.
/en-us/attractions/charoen-krung/: Things to do on Charoen Krung Road in Bangkok: tour the Central Post Office building with its design center, then shop records, books and homewares at Warehouse 30. Map tips for each separate stop.
/en-us/attractions/chatuchak-market/: Chatuchak Weekend Market hours and map tips: open Saturdays and Sundays 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. Know which sections sell clothes, vintage and art, when the plant market runs and the closest train stops.
/en-us/attractions/chiang-mai-night-baza: Chiang Mai Night Bazaar runs every evening on Chang Khlan Road, roughly 4 to 11:30 p.m. Shop crafts and souvenirs, grab dinner nearby, and compare it with the Saturday and Sunday walking streets.
/en-us/attractions/chiang-mai-night-safa: Is Chiang Mai Night Safari worth it? Book entry with shows and park transport from about US$20, ride two safari routes for giraffes, zebras, tigers and lions, and don’t confuse it with the zoo.
/en-us/attractions/chiang-mai-zoo/: Chiang Mai Zoo ticket prices: 350 baht for adults and 120 baht for kids under 135 cm, plus a separate aquarium ticket. See the new capybara exhibit, penguins and golf cart rental below Doi Suthep.
/en-us/attractions/damnoen-saduak-floati: Damnoen Saduak Floating Market day trip from Bangkok: plan on about two hours each way and arrive by 9 a.m. to see vendor boats selling fruit and noodles, then walk the canal or take a boat ride.
/en-us/attractions/erawan-museum/: Erawan Museum near Bangkok, home of the giant three-headed elephant, is open 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. with 500-baht adult tickets and English audio guides. See its stained-glass ceiling and Buddha images.
/en-us/attractions/jim-thompson-house/: Jim Thompson House in Bangkok is the silk entrepreneur’s teak home and art collection, seen on a guided tour. Open daily 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.; walk from Exit 1 of BTS National Stadium Station.
/en-us/attractions/khao-kheow-open-zoo/: Want to see Moo Deng? Khao Kheow Open Zoo in Chonburi is the baby pygmy hippo’s home. Get hours (8 a.m.–5 p.m.), 350-baht adult tickets, penguin parade and elephant swim times, and transport costs.
/en-us/attractions/khao-san-road/: Khao San Road in Bangkok is a 300-meter backpacker strip packed with hostels, bars, clubs and street food. See what it is like day and night, how to get there from Sam Yot MRT, and noise tips.
/en-us/attractions/khlong-lat-mayom-floa: Khlong Lat Mayom is a local weekend floating market in Bangkok, open 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays. Try grilled fish, boat noodles and coconut sweets by the canal.
/en-us/attractions/mae-klong-railway-mar: Mae Klong Railway Market train times and safety tips: watch vendors pull back awnings as the train rolls through. Entry is free; from Bangkok by rail you take a train, a ferry and a second train.
/en-us/attractions/museum-siam/: Museum Siam is a hands-on Bangkok museum about what makes Thai culture Thai, from food to clothing. Open Tuesday through Sunday 10 a.m. to 6 p.m., tickets 100 baht, steps from Sanam Chai MRT Exit 1.
/en-us/attractions/nakhon-ratchasima-zoo: Korat Zoo in Nakhon Ratchasima is a savanna-style open zoo with giraffes, zebras, lions and white rhinos. Foreign adult tickets are 350 baht; shuttles are 15–30 baht a ride and golf carts are hourly.
/en-us/attractions/national-museum-bangk: National Museum Bangkok tickets are 240 baht, and it closes Mondays, Tuesdays and holidays. Join a free English volunteer tour at 9:30 a.m. to see Buddhist art and royal funeral chariots.
/en-us/attractions/nimmanhaemin/: Nimman Road in Chiang Mai is the city’s cafe and boutique district. Explore Soi 1 for handmade candles and embroidered bags, Soi 17 for an artist’s gallery cafe, and One Nimman for shopping and food.
/en-us/attractions/nong-khai-aquarium/: Nong Khai Aquarium on the Mekong is known for its 34-meter tunnel sloping from saltwater tanks down to freshwater river fish. See what is on each floor and why it is apart from Khon Kaen’s zoo.
/en-us/attractions/phuket-aquarium/: Phuket Aquarium at Cape Panwa: hours 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., tunnel diver feeding at 11 a.m., a touch pool and animated films every 30 minutes. Don’t confuse it with Aquaria Phuket in the mall.
/en-us/attractions/phuket-old-town/: Things to do in Phuket Old Town: walk Thalang Road’s colorful Sino-Portuguese shophouses and murals, visit Thai Hua Museum, eat Hokkien noodles and dim sum, and time your trip for the Sunday market.
/en-us/attractions/safari-world/: Safari World Bangkok with kids: drive or ride the coach through Safari Park, then walk Marine Park for dolphin and stunt shows. Closed Mondays; tickets from US$30 for guests over 100 cm tall.
/en-us/attractions/sea-life-bangkok/: SEA LIFE Bangkok tickets and feeding times: the Siam Paragon aquarium is open 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. Plan at least 90 minutes for the Ocean Tunnel, Shark Walk and free penguin and shark feedings.
/en-us/attractions/taling-chan-floating-: Taling Chan Floating Market is a laid-back weekend market in Bangkok, open 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. Grab seafood and boat noodles on a floating dining raft, or book a separate long-tail canal boat tour.
/en-us/attractions/waghor-aquarium/: Waghor Aquarium near Prachuap Khiri Khan is a science-park aquarium with a glass tunnel and six habitat zones, from mangroves to coral reefs. Open 9 a.m. to 3:45 p.m.; groups apply two weeks ahead.
/en-us/attractions/wat-arun/: Wat Arun (Temple of Dawn) hours and tickets: open 8 a.m. to 6 p.m., 200 baht for foreign visitors. Take the ferry over from Wat Pho or walk from Itsaraphap MRT, and see the ceramic-studded prang.
/en-us/attractions/wat-pho/: Wat Pho tickets cost 300 baht, and the temple is open 8:30 a.m. to 8 p.m. See the giant 46-meter Reclining Buddha and colorful royal chedis, then get a Thai massage, 5 minutes from Sanam Chai MRT.
/en-us/attractions/wat-phra-kaew/: Visiting the Emerald Buddha at Wat Phra Kaew? Entry comes with the 500-baht Grand Palace ticket, sold 8:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.; kids under 120 cm are free. See the Ramakien murals and where to enter.
/en-us/attractions/wat-phra-mahathat-nak: Planning a trip to Nakhon Si Thammarat? Wat Phra Mahathat is the south’s most important relic temple, with a golden-spired chedi, monks’ quarters and traditions like the cloth-wrapping ceremony.
/en-us/attractions/wat-phra-si-sanphet/: Wat Phra Si Sanphet is Ayutthaya’s most photographed ruin: three bell-shaped chedis honoring three kings on the old royal palace grounds. Learn their history and how to explore the hall foundations.
/en-us/attractions/wat-phra-singh/: Wat Phra Singh is one of Chiang Mai’s most revered Old City temples. Tickets are 50 baht, hours 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.; see the Lanna Buddha in Lai Kham Viharn and murals of daily life from the 1860s.
/en-us/attractions/wat-phra-yai-samui/: Visiting the Big Buddha on Koh Samui? Wat Phra Yai’s 12-meter golden Buddha, built in 1972, sits on tiny Koh Fan, reached by a causeway. Learn its history and how to behave at an active temple.
/en-us/attractions/wat-plai-laem/: Wat Plai Laem in Koh Samui is the temple with a many-armed white Guanyin rising from a pond. See the roughly 20-meter statue and the smiling Phra Sangkatchai, and pair the visit with the Big Buddha.
/en-us/attractions/wat-rong-khun/: White Temple Chiang Rai hours and tickets: Wat Rong Khun is open 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. for 200 baht. It sits 14 km from downtown, so budget travel time to see artist Chalermchai Kositpipat’s masterpiece.
/en-us/attractions/wat-rong-suea-ten/: Blue Temple Chiang Rai: Wat Rong Suea Ten is free to enter, open 7 a.m. to 8 p.m., and about 4 km from downtown toward the airport. See its sapphire-blue hall and the naga sculptures at the door.
/en-us/attractions/wat-si-chum-sukhothai: Wat Si Chum is the Sukhothai temple where a giant 15-meter seated Buddha peers through a slit in the wall. It sits outside the park’s central zone with its own zone ticket; open 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.
/en-us/attractions/wat-suthat/: Wat Suthat and the Giant Swing in Bangkok: temple tickets are 100 baht, 8:30 a.m. to 8 p.m. See the towering bronze Buddha and murals, and note the museum opens only Fridays, weekends and holidays.
/en-us/attractions/wat-yai-chai-mongkhon: Wat Yai Chai Mongkhon tickets are 40 baht, open 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. This Ayutthaya temple’s giant chedi honors King Naresuan’s 1592 victory, and a large Reclining Buddha greets you by the entrance.
/en-us/attractions/wualai-saturday-marke: Chiang Mai Saturday Night Market on Wua Lai Road runs about 5 to 10 p.m. south of Chiang Mai Gate. Shop handmade silver, lacquerware and hill-tribe textiles, then grab pad Thai from food stalls.
/en-us/attractions/yaowarat-chinatown/: Bangkok Chinatown guide: Yaowarat Road is lined with gold shops, Chinese shrines and seafood spots serving steamed fish and crab. Find tea shops, dried seafood grocers and Vanich Road bargains.
/en-us/beaches/chaweng/: Chaweng Beach in Koh Samui is the island’s long white-sand strip, packed with resorts. Get tips on getting there, telling it apart from Chaweng Noi, and red flag and lifeguard rules before you swim.
/en-us/beaches/cities/ko-chang/: Best beaches on Koh Chang: pick White Sand Beach for restaurants and shops steps away, or Klong Prao for a wide palm-fringed shore. Plan your ferry arrival and check red flags before swimming.
/en-us/beaches/cities/pattaya/: Best beaches in Pattaya: Pattaya Beach along Beach Road puts hotels, dining and shopping right by the sand, while Jomtien to the south is longer and quieter. Map, access and safety flags.
/en-us/beaches/cities/phuket/: Best beaches in Phuket for your trip: busy Patong for dining and shopping, Karon for long sandy walks, or Kata Yai’s smaller bay. See the beach map, access tips and swim safety flags.
/en-us/beaches/hua-hin/: Hua Hin Beach sits right next to town, great for a stroll with parents or kids. Can you ride horses there? Ask if rides operate that day and agree on the price first. Swim only when flags allow.
/en-us/beaches/jomtien/: Is Jomtien Beach worth it? This long, relaxed shoreline south of Pattaya has seafront hotels and restaurants. Tell your driver the beach, not the bus terminal, and stay clear of water sports areas.
/en-us/beaches/karon/: Karon Beach in Phuket is a long white-sand beach for slow walks north of Kata. Note that Karon Noi is hotel-access only, waves can be strong, and red flags mean no swimming that day.
/en-us/beaches/kata/: Kata Beach Phuket: a small, scenic bay with Ko Pu offshore, plus hotels, bars and souvenir shops. Learn how Kata Yai differs from Kata Noi and where to swim away from surfers and water sports.
/en-us/beaches/klong-prao/: Klong Prao Beach on Koh Chang is a wide, palm-lined beach south of White Sand. Ask your hotel where to get dropped off with luggage, and skip swimming at the rocky Laem Chai Chet point.
/en-us/beaches/lamai/: Is Lamai Beach in Koh Samui good for kids? This palm-lined beach south of Chaweng has deep water and strong waves in places, so keep children close and leave time for walks and meals.
/en-us/beaches/patong/: Patong Beach in Phuket puts the sand steps from hotels, restaurants and shopping. See how to get there by car, where to swim clear of boats and water sports gear, and what beach flags mean.
/en-us/beaches/wong-duean/: Ao Wong Duean on Koh Samet is a crescent bay of soft white sand. Book a boat from Ban Phe straight to Wong Duean or land at Na Dan Pier and cross the island, then follow the day’s flags.
/en-us/cameras/chaam-thew-talay/: Cha-am live webcam near Thew Talay: CCTV snapshots refresh every few minutes instead of streaming video. Check the time stamp on each photo to see current sky and conditions before you head out.
/en-us/cameras/chainat-chao-phraya/: Chai Nat live webcam on the Chao Phraya River: a CCTV-style feed of the river and dam, opened through Webcamera24. Great for river scenery beyond the beaches; the camera owner is unverified.
/en-us/cameras/chiangmai-weather-view/: Chiang Mai live webcam roundup: check the sky over different parts of the city with public CCTV cameras and updated photos on EaseWeather. Note each image’s location and time stamp.
/en-us/cameras/chiangrai-mae-yao/: Chiang Rai live webcam at Ban Mae Yao: a CCTV-style view of northern mountains and temples, linked via Webcamera24. Use it to preview the hills before a trip north; streaming status is unverified.
/en-us/cameras/chiangrai-wat-thep/: Wat Thep Bun Yuen live webcam in Chiang Rai: see the temple and mountain backdrop on this CCTV-style feed listed by Webcamera24. It shows scenery only, not entrances or visiting areas.
/en-us/cameras/huahin-centara/: Want to see Hua Hin before you go? This live webcam streams the beach right in front of Centara Grand Beach Resort via YouTube, a CCTV-style shot of sand and Gulf water you can watch full screen.
/en-us/cameras/huahin-kba/: Hua Hin live webcam from Kiteboarding Asia: a CCTV-style shot of the sea and sky off Hua Hin Beach, handy for kitesurfers. It does not show whether lessons are running, so check with the school.
/en-us/cameras/krabi-ao-nang-coast/: Ao Nang live webcam in Krabi: a CCTV coastal radar feed from government agency GISTDA showing open water and sky. Useful for checking weather, but not proof that boat tours to Railay are running.
/en-us/cameras/lanta-hat-lant/: Koh Lanta live webcam: a CCTV-style sea view listed under Hat Lant on Webcamera24. Check the island’s water and sky before your trip; the precise beach and camera operator are unverified.
/en-us/cameras/nakhon-cha-uat/: Cha-uat River live webcam in Nakhon Si Thammarat: a CCTV-style feed of the riverside area linked via Webcamera24. Preview southern Thailand’s river landscape; the exact location is not verified.
/en-us/cameras/pathum-chao-phraya/: Pathum Thani live webcam: watch the Chao Phraya River and the town along its banks on a CCTV-style feed collected by Tufaq. A city river view rather than a beach, just north of Bangkok.
/en-us/cameras/pattaya-beach-panorama/: Pattaya Beach live webcam from SkylineWebcams: a sweeping CCTV-style panorama of the shoreline and the Gulf of Thailand. Use it for a big-picture look at the beach before your Pattaya vacation.
/en-us/cameras/phangan-sanskara/: Haad Rin live webcam on Koh Phangan: a CCTV-style feed from House of Sanskara looking out to sea. Check waves and skies on YouTube or in the page player before heading to the island.
/en-us/cameras/phuket-cape-panwa/: Freedivers and beach fans can preview southeast Phuket on this Cape Panwa live webcam, a CCTV-style feed from NĀMA Freediving facing the bay and horizon. Weather may differ from Patong.
/en-us/cameras/phuket-karon-marina/: Karon Beach live webcam in Phuket: Marina Phuket Resort’s CCTV-style feed looks over the south end of the beach, waves and sky. Pick this one if Karon, not Patong or Kata, is where you are staying.
/en-us/cameras/phuket-kata-surf/: Kata Beach Phuket live webcam for surfers: SSS Phuket shares CCTV-style photos of waves rolling in, refreshed periodically rather than streamed. Check the time stamp and obey beach flags.
/en-us/cameras/phuket-patong-panorama/: Patong live webcam in Phuket: a CCTV-style panorama from town rooftops and greenery out to the bay, streamed via a public Ivideon player. See what surrounds Patong Beach beyond the sand.
/en-us/cameras/phuket-patong-tower/: Patong Beach live webcam from Patong Tower’s 15th floor in Phuket: a CCTV-style feed looking down over the shoreline and Andaman Sea. Tune in near sunset to watch the sky change color.
/en-us/cameras/samet-cocoon/: Checking the weather on Koh Samet? The Cocoon Hostel streams a live webcam near Na Dan Pier pointing back at the mainland, a CCTV-style look at waves and clouds. It is not a ferry schedule.
/en-us/cameras/samui-bang-rak/: Bang Rak Beach live webcam on Koh Samui: SkylineWebcams streams this CCTV-style view of the north shore. Compare it with Lamai and Crystal Bay cams to decide which part of Samui suits you.
/en-us/cameras/samui-banyan-tree/: Banyan Tree Samui live webcam: a high CCTV-style view from the resort’s hillside over the bay and beach on Koh Samui. Choose it for the big picture rather than a close-up of the surf.
/en-us/cameras/samui-baobab/: Lamai Beach live webcam on Koh Samui from Baobab: a ground-level CCTV-style feed of sand and breaking waves along the palm-fringed bay. Switch to the Black Pearl cam for another angle.
/en-us/cameras/samui-black-pearl/: Lamai Beach live webcam on Koh Samui from Black Pearl: watch the surf rolling in on a CCTV-style YouTube feed. Want another angle of Lamai? The Baobab camera covers the same beach.
/en-us/cameras/samui-bophut-beach/: Bophut Beach live webcam on Koh Samui: SkylineWebcams’ CCTV-style feed faces the water along the north coast. Confirm on the original page whether it is broadcasting before you tune in.
/en-us/cameras/samui-choengmon/: Choeng Mon Beach live webcam on Koh Samui: a CCTV-style feed of the northeast shore and waves. Planning to stay in Choeng Mon? Use this cam rather than the Bophut or Bang Rak feeds.
/en-us/cameras/samui-crystal-bay/: Is the water clear at Crystal Bay today? Crystal Bay Yacht Club’s live webcam gives a CCTV-style, close-up look at the white sand and waves of Thongtakian Bay on Koh Samui, on YouTube or here.
/en-us/cameras/samui-crystal-beach/: Silver Beach live webcam on Koh Samui: a CCTV-style SamuiWebcam view, labeled Crystal Bay Beach Cam on Webcamtaxi, showing the sea and shore. Preview this stretch of coast before you go.
/en-us/cameras/samui-two-palms/: Bang Po Beach live webcam on Koh Samui: Two Palms streams a close CCTV-style view of the shoreline and sea on YouTube. Handy for checking this stretch of coast before you book a stay.
/en-us/cameras/tao-island-skyline/: Koh Tao live webcam: SkylineWebcams streams a CCTV-style view across a bay toward nearby islands. Use it to preview Koh Tao scenery; it does not point out a specific beach entrance.
/en-us/coupons/: Looking for Thailand travel deals? This page collects official offers for US travelers and sends you straight to the source, including Grab’s official site and its Google Play app page.
/en-us/destinations/: Planning a Thailand vacation from the US? Start here for U.S. passport entry rules and TDAC, the best time to visit by region, and destination ideas from Bangkok and Chiang Mai to the islands.
/en-us/entry/: Thailand entry requirements for U.S. travelers: visa exemption up to 30 days from September 15, 2026, the free TDAC arrival card, and proof of 20,000 baht per person in funds at immigration.
/en-us/entry/tourist-visa/: Do Americans need a Thailand tourist visa? Compare visa exemption with single-entry and multiple-entry visas, plus Los Angeles consulate documents like bank statements showing $700 per person.
/en-us/food-delivery/: Best food delivery apps in Thailand for US visitors: GrabFood, LINE MAN, ShopeeFood and Robinhood compared, with tips on getting orders to your hotel lobby and checking delivery fees before paying.
/en-us/food-delivery/grabfood/: Can you use a US credit card on GrabFood in Thailand? Yes, Grab lists foreign cards, with a 3% fee plus any charge from your bank. Learn to order to your hotel, pay cash and cancel an order.
/en-us/food-delivery/line-man/: How to use LINE MAN in Thailand: log in with a LINE ID, choose food delivery, pin your hotel and confirm the checkout total. Learn about foreign card payments and what to do if items are missing.
/en-us/food-delivery/robinhood/: Robinhood app for food delivery in Bangkok: see which restaurants deliver to your hotel, compare menu prices and delivery fees, and check whether your foreign card works before you place an order.
/en-us/food-delivery/shopeefood/: Using ShopeeFood in Thailand: open the Thai Shopee app, switch to ShopeeFood (not regular shopping), set your hotel address and pin, and review delivery fees and payment options before ordering.
/en-us/food/: Where to eat and drink with a view in Thailand: rooftop picks like Sky Beach and Mahanakhon SkyWalk in Bangkok, HONG’s Sky Bar in Chiang Mai and STAR by Silavadee on Samui, plus food delivery tips.
/en-us/rooftops/abar-rooftop/: Gin lovers, take note: ABar Rooftop at the Bangkok Marriott Marquis Queen’s Park on Sukhumvit 22 pours a wide gin list under the city lights. Hours are 5 p.m. to 1 a.m.; get there by Grab or taxi.
/en-us/rooftops/above-eleven/: Above Eleven Bangkok: a 33rd-floor rooftop at Fraser Suites Sukhumvit known for Nikkei cuisine, Pisco Sours and DJ sets, with salsa on Wednesdays. Open 5 p.m. to 2 a.m., with no regular days off.
/en-us/rooftops/akara-sky-hanuman/: Akara Sky Hanuman is a Hanuman-themed rooftop bar at One City Centre in Bangkok, open 5 p.m. to 2 a.m. Know how the bar, observation deck and night market differ before you buy anything.
/en-us/rooftops/alfresco-64/: Alfresco 64 at lebua in Bangkok is a 64th-floor whisky bar styled like a yacht, with DJs and skyline views. Guests must be 20 or older and dress smart casual; open 5 p.m. to 12:30 a.m.
/en-us/rooftops/attic-by-octave/: ATTIC by Octave is a speakeasy-style rooftop on Floor 47 of the Bangkok Marriott Hotel Sukhumvit, serving Mexican-inspired cocktails and bar bites with Sukhumvit views. Reservations accepted.
/en-us/rooftops/baba-nest/: Is Baba Nest in Phuket worth it? This sunset-only rooftop at Sri Panwa opens 5 to 8 p.m., requires a reservation, and has a 3,000-baht minimum spend for non-hotel guests. Here is how to plan it.
/en-us/rooftops/baiyoke-observatory/: Baiyoke Sky Tower observation deck in Bangkok: head up after shopping Pratunam to the indoor 77th floor and the revolving 84th floor deck. Open 10 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily, with taxi directions.
/en-us/rooftops/barbu-pattaya/: Looking for a kid-friendly rooftop in Pattaya? BARBÙ on Floor 24 of Siam@Siam Design Hotel welcomes families for Mediterranean sharing plates and city views, unlike the adults-only Skybar above.
/en-us/rooftops/brewski-rooftop/: Brewski Rooftop Bar at Radisson Blu Plaza Bangkok is the craft beer pick among Sukhumvit rooftops, on Floors 29–30. Open 5 p.m. to 1 a.m. daily, so you can catch sunset with a pint and bar snacks.
/en-us/rooftops/char-rooftop/: CHAR Rooftop Bar at Hotel Indigo Bangkok on Wireless Road features live music and signature cocktails on Floor 26. Meet at the rooftop bar, not CHAR Restaurant one floor down, which is separate.
/en-us/rooftops/cocoa-xo/: Cocoa XO in Bangkok is a dessert-and-drinks rooftop at Centara Grand at CentralWorld: think handmade chocolate paired with cognac cocktails. Open 4 p.m. to 1 a.m., guests 20 and older only.
/en-us/rooftops/cru-champagne-bar/: CRU Champagne Bar sits on Floor 59 of Centara Grand at CentralWorld, one of Bangkok’s top spots for bubbly and oysters at sunset. Open 5 p.m. to 1 a.m., 20 and older only; great for anniversaries.
/en-us/rooftops/distil-lebua/: Distil at lebua State Tower is a 64th-floor Bangkok lounge for premium spirits, cocktails and cigars. You must be 20 or older; dress smart casual. Open 5 p.m. to 12:30 a.m. with taxi directions.
/en-us/rooftops/doi-suthep-viewpoint/: How to visit the Doi Suthep viewpoint in Chiang Mai: agree on a round-trip fare with a red songthaew driver, take the stairs or cable car up, then see the golden chedi and city views.
/en-us/rooftops/flute-lebua/: Bangkok champagne bar with live jazz: Flûte by lebua pours Bollinger with oysters and caviar on Floor 64 of State Tower. Jazz nightly except Monday; 5 p.m. to 12:30 a.m., ages 7+ with adults.
/en-us/rooftops/hongs-sky-bar/: Best rooftop bar in Chiang Mai for sunset? HONG’s Sky Bar at the InterContinental The Mae Ping faces Doi Suthep, with cocktails and small plates 4 p.m. to midnight. Reserve; it may close in rain.
/en-us/rooftops/horizon-pattaya/: Horizon at Hilton Pattaya is a 34th-floor rooftop restaurant and bar overlooking Pattaya Bay, ideal for an anniversary dinner. Reserve on Hilton’s dining site and arrive in time for sunset.
/en-us/rooftops/iris-wild-iris/: IRIS and WILD IRIS at SO/ Bangkok is a rooftop on Floors 29–30 overlooking Lumpini Park, with Italian food, aperitivo and DJs. Open 5 p.m. to midnight, until 1 a.m. Fridays and Saturdays.
/en-us/rooftops/lebua-no3/: lebua No. 3 in Bangkok is a sleek 52nd-floor bar at State Tower devoted to gin, vodka and caviar. Open 5 p.m. to 12:30 a.m.; guests must be 20 or older and dressed smart casual. Get taxi directions.
/en-us/rooftops/mahanakhon-skywalk/: Mahanakhon SkyWalk tickets and tips: Bangkok’s glass-floor deck on Floor 78, 310 m up, plus an indoor deck on Floor 74. Open 10 a.m. to midnight; book a time slot online. Kids 8–12 ticket.
/en-us/rooftops/octave-rooftop/: Octave Rooftop Bar in Thong Lo, Bangkok, crowns the Marriott Hotel Sukhumvit with 360-degree views, food and drinks. Open 5 p.m. to 2 a.m.; smart casual dress code and online reservations.
/en-us/rooftops/pastel-rooftop/: Pastel Rooftop Bar on Floor 22 of Aira Hotel, Sukhumvit Soi 11, combines Mediterranean dining, cocktails and live music. Open 5 p.m. to 1 a.m.; check the events calendar if you want a specific show.
/en-us/rooftops/phi-phi-viewpoint-2/: Phi Phi Viewpoint 2 hike: climb Koh Phi Phi Don’s hilltop lookout for a sweeping view over the bay and village. Map out the route from your hotel first and bring friends who love travel photos.
/en-us/rooftops/phra-tamnak-viewpoint/: Pattaya viewpoint at Phra Tamnak Hill: see the whole curve of Pattaya Beach and the city between Pattaya and Jomtien. Grab a ride up to skip the walk and line up a ride back down after sunset.
/en-us/rooftops/portrait-voyage-sky-bar/: Pattaya sky bar with ocean views: The Portrait of Voyage Sky Bar sits on Floor 33 at Grande Centre Point Voyage, open 11:30 a.m. to midnight. Go for sunset drinks rather than a sit-down dinner.
/en-us/rooftops/red-sky-bar/: Red Sky Bar in Bangkok, on Floor 56 of Centara Grand at CentralWorld, is famous for its arch and open skyline views. Open 4 p.m. to 1 a.m.; stop by for cocktails after shopping at CentralWorld.
/en-us/rooftops/red-sky-restaurant/: Red Sky Restaurant in Bangkok serves steaks, seafood and European dishes on Floor 55 of Centara Grand at CentralWorld. Dinner is 5 p.m. to 1 a.m.; reserve a table for a birthday or anniversary.
/en-us/rooftops/seen-riverside/: SEEN Restaurant and Bar at Avani+ Riverside Bangkok spans Floors 26–27 with indoor and outdoor seating, Chao Phraya River views and DJ sets. Use the hotel address to find it by taxi or Grab.
/en-us/rooftops/sin-rooftop/: SIN Rooftop Bar at Avani+ Riverside Bangkok is a Floor 27 open-air bar above the Chao Phraya. Open 5 p.m. to 1 a.m.; it is a different venue from SEEN Restaurant, so pick the right meeting spot.
/en-us/rooftops/sirocco/: Sirocco at lebua is Bangkok’s classic romantic rooftop dinner, with Mediterranean food under the golden dome on Floor 63. Book ahead, and take the BTS to Saphan Taksin or a Grab in the heat.
/en-us/rooftops/sizzle-rooftop/: Sizzle Rooftop in Patong, Phuket, at Avista Hideaway MGallery, offers Andaman Sea and wooded hill views. The bar opens at 5:30 p.m. and dinner at 6 p.m. (last order 10:30 p.m.).
/en-us/rooftops/sky-bar/: Sky Bar Bangkok at lebua, the Hangover Part II rooftop: walk-in only, one drink minimum, smart casual (no flip-flops or tank tops), kids 7 and up with an adult. Order the Hangovertini on Floor 64.
/en-us/rooftops/sky-beach/: Sky Beach Bangkok at King Power Mahanakhon is an all-ages rooftop with cocktails, American comfort food and DJs. Open 10 a.m. to midnight, last entry 11 p.m.; seating is first come, first served.
/en-us/rooftops/sky-on-20/: Sky on 20 at Novotel Bangkok Sukhumvit 20 is a Floor 26 rooftop for cocktails, pizza and crab bruschetta. Open 5 p.m. to 1 a.m.; come Friday or Saturday night for DJ music with your group.
/en-us/rooftops/skybar-summer-club/: Skybar Summer Club in Pattaya is a 27th-floor pool party rooftop at Siam@Siam with Gulf of Thailand views, two pool levels and live DJs. Strictly 18 and over, so plan a night out with adults.
/en-us/rooftops/spectrum-lounge-bar/: Spectrum at Hyatt Regency Bangkok Sukhumvit has two vibes: dinner with a live band on Floor 29 and an open-air DJ bar on Floor 30. Open 5:30 p.m. to 1 a.m.; no sandals, tank tops or athletic wear.
/en-us/rooftops/spire-rooftop/: Spire Rooftop Bar at Dusit Thani Bangkok sits on Floor 39 under the hotel’s golden spire, with cocktails by the Tropic City team. Open 5 p.m. to 1 a.m.; under-20s welcome until 7 p.m. only.
/en-us/rooftops/star-silavadee/: STAR by Silavadee is a Koh Samui rooftop over Lamai Bay where you can dine at sunken tables in the infinity pool. Open 5:30 to 11 p.m.; reserve online, and the resort is between Chaweng and Lamai.
/en-us/rooftops/surface-patong/: The Surface at La Flora Resort is a rooftop restaurant and bar overlooking Patong Beach and the Andaman Sea in Phuket. Come for a sunset dinner after the beach, and book your ride home in advance.
/en-us/rooftops/threesixty-rooftop/: Riverside rooftop bar in Bangkok: ThreeSixty tops the Millennium Hilton on Floor 31, 5 p.m. to 1 a.m., with wide Chao Phraya views. Bring your camera at sunset as boats pass and the skyline glows.
/en-us/rooftops/tichuca-rooftop/: Tichuca Rooftop Bar in Bangkok is the plant-filled rooftop on Floor 46 of the T-One Building, with house DJs, skyline views and creative cocktails. Show your driver the English or Thai address.
/en-us/rooftops/twilight-sky/: Twilight Sky at The SIS Kata, an adults-only resort in Phuket, is a rooftop restaurant and bar overlooking Kata Beach. Call ahead to reserve, and go on Thursday for live music and steak night.
/en-us/rooftops/vanilla-sky/: Vanilla Sky Bar in Kamala, Phuket, at Cape Sienna is a sunset rooftop over Kamala Bay with a Smoky Cinnamon cocktail, draft beer and charcoal-grilled bites. Open 5 p.m. to midnight; reserve by email.
/en-us/rooftops/yao-rooftop/: Yao Rooftop Bar at Bangkok Marriott The Surawongse pairs Chinese-style decor with dim sum, cocktails and mocktails, overlooking old and new Bangkok. Open 5 p.m. to 1 a.m., good for non-drinkers too.
/en-us/transport/: Thailand transportation for US visitors: pick a topic, from Bangkok trains and stations to intercity buses, ferries, domestic flights, ride hailing, motorbike taxis and songthaews (in Korean).
/en-us/travel-seasons/rainy-dry/: When is rainy season in Thailand? Most of the country gets rain mid-May to mid-October, but Koh Samui is wettest in November. Compare Phuket vs. Samui and get tips for a rainy-day vacation.
/en-us/beaches/cities/hua-hin/: Hua Hin beaches compared: the town beach beside this royal retreat town and Khao Takiab to the south. Combine a seaside walk with hill scenery, treating the temple and sand as separate stops.
/en-us/beaches/cities/ko-samet/: Ko Samet beaches compared: white-sand Sai Kaew and the crescent bay of Ao Wong Duean. Arrange your boat from Ban Phe on the mainland and your arrival pier first, then the onward trip to the beach.
/en-us/beaches/cities/samui/: Ko Samui beaches compared: Chaweng and Lamai on the east coast. Both have accommodation and restaurants, but their sand and seabed differ, so weigh scenery and swimming conditions together.
